subject: Sensing needs SignalFrame, DetectionEvent, calibration summary
body: For M1 please include: SignalFrame {t, source: simulator|hr-strap|manual, hr, rr[] in ms, quality 0..1}; DetectionEvent {id, t, kind: drift|manual, confidence 0..1, window {startT, endT, hr, rmssd, quality}, targetEmotionId, gate {consecutive, refractoryMs, sham}}; a calibration summary per emotion plus neutral {hr:{mean,sd}, lnRmssd:{mean,sd}, windows, recordedAt}. Question: does the calibration summary live on each Profile v2 emotion, or in a separate Calibration doc? Fixtures for these are what I'll build against. Plan: sensing/PLAN.md.
